variations.name: Folio
variations.rationale: Literary-journal opening: warm sheet, oxblood double-rule mast, and a two-column hero that holds name, role, and bio in one viewport. Contents rail tracks chapters without hiding copy; type, measure, and rules do the work instead of filler blocks.

variations.name: Elevation
variations.rationale: Replaced the house drawing with a Swiss poster canvas: oversized system type, nested ivory/ink slabs, and work copy in one lockup. Spread is a real labeled range that offsets the planes, with a composed CSS default if JS is off. Hover ties slabs to the matching copy; reduced motion drops transitions. All given facts and URLs remain, nothing extra.

variations.name: Night Desk
variations.rationale: A framed nocturnal reading room: lamp-warmed serif, gold hairlines, and a labeled side index instead of anonymous dots. Identity, bio, and focus sit in the first viewport; a reading-light switch changes the room without gating facts.

variations.name: Measure
variations.rationale: Asymmetric Swiss split: sticky ink identity versus a cool reading column, joined by a red rule and ruler ticks. Measure radios (narrow, reading, wide) are a typesetter’s control—they reshape the column without filtering or inventing biography.

variations.name: Signal
variations.rationale: Poster lockup in cobalt, cream, and gold with crop marks and a once-only rule draw. Work is full-width bands that lift on hover and focus; colorway radios reprint the field. Kinetic through composition and state, not animation loops.
